Cheddi Jagan was a Guyanese dentist and politician, the founder of the People's Progressive Party, premier of British Guiana from 1961 to 1964 and president of Guyana from 1992 to 1997.

The son of Indian sugar workers, he studied in the United States and returned to lead workers against the sugar planters. His party won the first elections under universal suffrage in 1953, but Britain, fearing communism, sent troops and suspended the constitution after 133 days.

He won again in 1957 and 1961. The United States and Britain, wary of a Marxist government during the Cold War, worked against him, and changes to the voting system brought Forbes Burnham to power in 1964. After decades in opposition he won the free election of 1992. He is honoured in Guyana as its foremost national leader.
sum: Cheddi Jagan was a Guyanese dentist and politician, the founder of the People's Progressive Party, premier of British Guiana from 1961 to 1964 and president of Guyana from 1992 to 1997.
